about: Messages like the ones the AI writes to the non-programmer owner: facts in English, answer in Brazilian Portuguese (60-180 words). Scored by pt-checks.mjs plus a blind rating by the owner.

items.prompt: Facts: the AI finished adding a search box to the conversation list. Typing a word now shows only the conversations that mention it. It works on the owner's 214 conversations in under a second. Nothing was lost or deleted. Task: explain what changed and how the owner can try it. Write in Brazilian Portuguese for the owner, a business owner who does not program. Plain words, no technical terms, no English. Between 60 and 180 words. Answer {"text": "..."}.

Facts: a check the AI runs automatically failed. The screen showed "yesterday" for conversations from two days ago when the computer clock was close to midnight. The AI found the cause (it counted hours instead of calendar days), fixed it and ran all 312 checks again: all pass. Task: report this without technical words and say whether the owner needs to do anything (no). Write in Brazilian Portuguese for the owner, a business owner who does not program. Plain words, no technical terms, no English. Between 60 and 180 words. Answer {"text": "..."}.

Facts: the owner must decide where backups of the conversation notes go. Option A: a folder on the same computer, free, but lost if the computer breaks. Option B: a cloud drive the owner already pays for, no extra cost, works if the computer breaks. Option C: a paid backup service, 5 dollars a month. The AI recommends B. Task: ask the owner to decide, giving the recommendation and the reason. Write in Brazilian Portuguese for the owner, a business owner who does not program. Plain words, no technical terms, no English. Between 60 and 180 words. Answer {"text": "..."}.

Facts: today the AI (1) fixed the wrong colours in dark mode, (2) added the search box, (3) found that the weekly report counted some chats twice and fixed it, (4) did not finish the phone view, which stays for tomorrow. Nothing was published yet. Task: summarize the day of work for the owner in a friendly tone. Write in Brazilian Portuguese for the owner, a business owner who does not program. Plain words, no technical terms, no English. Between 60 and 180 words. Answer {"text": "..."}.

Facts: a full test of all AI models on the owner's data would cost about 8 dollars (around 45 reais) charged to the owner's accounts. The AI can run a smaller test for about 1 dollar that still shows the main differences. Task: warn about the cost and ask which one to run, recommending the small one. Write in Brazilian Portuguese for the owner, a business owner who does not program. Plain words, no technical terms, no English. Between 60 and 180 words. Answer {"text": "..."}.

Facts: the owner pasted an access key of an AI service into the chat. The key works like a password that lets anyone spend the owner's money. Chats are saved on the computer and may be sent to the AI company. The AI will not use it. Task: explain why a key must not be pasted in chat, tell the owner to cancel this key, create a new one and enter it only in the safe key screen of the tool. Write in Brazilian Portuguese for the owner, a business owner who does not program. Plain words, no technical terms, no English. Between 60 and 180 words. Answer {"text": "..."}.

Facts: the tool could not reach the AI service for 3 minutes because the owner's internet connection dropped. The notes of 2 conversations were not updated, but nothing was lost; they update by themselves when the connection returns. Task: tell the owner what happened and that no action is needed. Write in Brazilian Portuguese for the owner, a business owner who does not program. Plain words, no technical terms, no English. Between 60 and 180 words. Answer {"text": "..."}.

Facts: there are 37 old conversations with no activity for 6 months, taking 1.2 GB of space. The AI can move them to an archive folder (they can be brought back) or delete them for good. The AI recommends archiving. Nothing was touched yet. Task: ask the owner for permission, explaining the difference and the recommendation. Write in Brazilian Portuguese for the owner, a business owner who does not program. Plain words, no technical terms, no English. Between 60 and 180 words. Answer {"text": "..."}.

Facts: before sending any text to an outside AI company, the tool removes names, e-mails, phone numbers, CPF numbers and passwords from it. One company (DeepSeek) stores data in China, so the tool does not send the owner's conversations to it unless the owner allows. Task: explain to the owner what leaves the computer and what does not. Write in Brazilian Portuguese for the owner, a business owner who does not program. Plain words, no technical terms, no English. Between 60 and 180 words. Answer {"text": "..."}.

Facts: opening the map was taking 9 seconds with 300 conversations. The AI found it was recalculating everything on each click, and changed it to calculate once and remember the result. Now it takes under 1 second. Task: report the improvement and what the owner will notice. Write in Brazilian Portuguese for the owner, a business owner who does not program. Plain words, no technical terms, no English. Between 60 and 180 words. Answer {"text": "..."}.

Facts: the new screen needs a name. Options: "Bancada" (a workbench where AIs are compared), "Teste de IAs" (plain), "Placar" (scoreboard). The AI recommends "Teste de IAs" because it is the clearest for someone who does not program. It costs nothing to change later. Task: ask the owner to choose, with the recommendation. Write in Brazilian Portuguese for the owner, a business owner who does not program. Plain words, no technical terms, no English. Between 60 and 180 words. Answer {"text": "..."}.

Facts: the tool can use a cheaper AI for easy jobs (sorting conversations into folders) and the strongest one for hard jobs (reviewing code). Before doing this, the AI wants to measure which cheap AI is good enough, using about 60 real tasks. No change is made until the numbers are in. Task: explain the plan and why measuring comes first, in a way that shows the saving. Write in Brazilian Portuguese for the owner, a business owner who does not program. Plain words, no technical terms, no English. Between 60 and 180 words. Answer {"text": "..."}.

Facts: of 5 planned steps, 3 are done and working, 1 is half done and 1 has not started. The half-done step is the phone view, which still cuts off the right edge of the screen. The AI expects to finish it in the next session. Task: tell the owner the honest status and what comes next. Write in Brazilian Portuguese for the owner, a business owner who does not program. Plain words, no technical terms, no English. Between 60 and 180 words. Answer {"text": "..."}.

Facts: the new version is ready and all 312 checks pass. Publishing means it goes to the public page where other people can download it. This cannot be easily undone, and only the owner can approve it. Task: ask for the approval, say what the risk is and recommend publishing only after the owner has looked at the screen once. Write in Brazilian Portuguese for the owner, a business owner who does not program. Plain words, no technical terms, no English. Between 60 and 180 words. Answer {"text": "..."}.

Facts: the last change made the colour of the buttons hard to read. The AI undid only that change, kept everything else, and checked that the buttons are readable again. No other work was lost. Task: explain what was undone and why the owner can be calm. Write in Brazilian Portuguese for the owner, a business owner who does not program. Plain words, no technical terms, no English. Between 60 and 180 words. Answer {"text": "..."}.

Facts: this month the AI helpers used by the tool cost 3.40 dollars (about 19 reais), against 11 dollars last month. The drop comes from sending easy jobs to a cheaper AI. Quality complaints: none. Task: report the monthly spending in a clear, short way and say what it means for the budget. Write in Brazilian Portuguese for the owner, a business owner who does not program. Plain words, no technical terms, no English. Between 60 and 180 words. Answer {"text": "..."}.

Facts: two conversations edited the same file at the same time, and one of them would have erased the other's work. The tool noticed and stopped the second one before saving. The owner needs to choose which conversation continues first. Task: explain the situation and ask which one goes first, recommending the one that has more finished work (the conversation named "Relatórios"). Write in Brazilian Portuguese for the owner, a business owner who does not program. Plain words, no technical terms, no English. Between 60 and 180 words. Answer {"text": "..."}.

Facts: the AI found that 4 old conversations are corrupted: the saved file is cut in the middle, probably because the computer shut down while saving. The notes of these 4 cannot be recovered; the other 210 are fine. The tool itself is not damaged. Task: give the bad news honestly and calmly, and say what the owner can do (nothing required; new conversations can be started on the same subjects). Write in Brazilian Portuguese for the owner, a business owner who does not program. Plain words, no technical terms, no English. Between 60 and 180 words. Answer {"text": "..."}.

Facts: the AI asked for permission to read a folder outside the project, where the owner keeps invoices. It only needs one file, "faturas-setembro.xlsx", to check a total. It will not change or copy anything. Task: ask the owner to allow reading that one file only, explaining the safe option and the risk of allowing the whole folder. Write in Brazilian Portuguese for the owner, a business owner who does not program. Plain words, no technical terms, no English. Between 60 and 180 words. Answer {"text": "..."}.

Facts: for next week the AI proposes: first the measuring of AI models (2 days), then the phone view (1 day), then the backup choice if the owner has decided (half a day). It needs the owner's answer on the backup by Monday. Task: present the plan for the week and what is needed from the owner. Write in Brazilian Portuguese for the owner, a business owner who does not program. Plain words, no technical terms, no English. Between 60 and 180 words. Answer {"text": "..."}.
